site.name: Albion Mine
overview: Albion Mine is a historic named mine in the Rico mining area of Dolores County, preserved as a distinct mine feature on USGS topographic mapping.
moreHistory: The mapped mine location provides a defensible identification target. This record does not claim that a historic opening or other working survives or is accessible today.
